index.title: Tibia Calculators
index.subtitle: 14 free tools for planning training, valuing your character and analysing results.

exercise-weapons.title: Exercise Weapons
exercise-weapons.description: Calculate how many exercise weapons you need for a target skill — with loyalty, double event and TC threshold.

skills.title: Training / Skills
skills.description: Time and cost to train from current to target skill on any weapon.

true-skill.title: True Skill
true-skill.description: Convert the displayed skill with loyalty bonus to base skill — the same value shown in highscores and Bazaar.

blessings.title: Blessings
blessings.description: Blessing cost and XP-loss protection at your level.

stamina.title: Stamina
stamina.description: Time to full stamina in hunt and offline modes — premium bonuses and regeneration windows included.

character-value.title: Character Value
character-value.description: Character valuation in TC: skills, features, progression, cosmetics and assets — with expandable breakdown.

imbuement.title: Imbuement cost
imbuement.description: Basic / Powerful / Epic tier costs per imbuement and astral source requirements.

weekly-tasks.title: Weekly Tasks
weekly-tasks.description: Maximum XP per weekly task by level and difficulty (Beginner / Adept / Expert / Master).

charms.title: Charms Damage
charms.description: Damage and percent bonus from charms for your vocation, skill and monster type.

experience.title: Experience / Levelling
experience.description: Total XP to a level, delta to target, and time at a given XP/h.

leech.title: Leech
leech.description: Leech percent from a party accounting for level differences between members.

exp-share.title: Exp Share
exp-share.description: XP split in a party using Tibia's formula based on level distance.

planners-charms.title: Charm Planner
planners-charms.description: Optimal charm point allocation for your vocation and build with a shareable link.

planners-wheel.title: Wheel of Destiny Planner
planners-wheel.description: Wheel of Destiny builds per vocation — with descriptions and gem recommendations.
